atoms.text: Jamie has just turned 9 and is having a birthday party this weekend. Read along with the text while he speaks.
atoms.sound: ssml: Jamie has just turned 9 and is having a birthday party this weekend. Read along with the text while he speaks.<break time='1000ms'/><voice voiceLang='en' voice='f12'><prosody pitch = '-1st'>For my party, we are going go-karting at 3pm. We are meeting everyone at the park at 12pm to have a picnic and cake. My friend Tilly is coming round at 10am because her mum has to work, so I’ll play with her for a bit before we go. We are also going to see a film at 6 o’clock this evening. By the time it’s over it’ll be quite late, but I’m allowed to stay up until 10 because it’s a special day!</prosody></voice>

hint.text: Chronological order means the order that things happen. Start with the earliest activity and end with the latest.
